item.title: Gertrude Smith
item.description: Gertrude Smith, 97, of Atmore, passed away Mon., January 26, 2026 in Foley. She was born to Ruby and Ollie Moye on December 25, 1928. She was a graduate of Escambia County in Atmore. She was a faithful member of First Baptist Church in Atmore, where she cherished her church family and friendships. A devoted stay-at-home mother, she poured her life into caring for her family. Her home was always immaculate: a reflection of the pride and love she put into everything she did. item.title: APD to recognize Law Enforcement Explorer program members in ceremony January 29 at city hall
item.description: The Atmore Police Department will recognize members of its inaugural Law Enforcement Explorer Program on Thurs., January 29, at 5 p.m. at city hall. The eight-week program was open to boys and girls ages 14–18, and was free of charge. Participants were required be in good standing with school administrators. item.description: Dog rescued, no injuries after fire heavily damages under-construction Ashley Street home in Atmore; cause remains undetermined, fire officials say.

item.title: FHSAA combines rural and Class 1A to create more even playing field for small schools
item.description: Florida High School Athletic Association officials recently voted to combine Rural Class and Class 1A into a single classification, according to reports. The new classification will begin with the upcoming season. This upcoming season, Northview will move from Class 1A Rural to Class 1A. According to FHSAA’s website, policy 12.3.2.1 requires at least 24 schools for there to be a rural classification.
